description: This file defines the SheetView class within the PhpSpreadsheet library. The class manages the view settings for a worksheet, including view type, zoom scale, and whether zeros are displayed. It provides methods to get and set these properties, with validation applied where appropriate.

classes.name: SheetView
classes.description: Represents the view configuration for a worksheet, including view type, zoom level, and zero display setting.

methods.name: getZoomScale
methods.description: Returns the current zoom scale setting.

methods.name: setZoomScale
methods.description: Sets the zoom scale, ensuring it is at least 1 or null.

methods.name: getZoomScaleNormal
methods.description: Returns the normal zoom scale setting.

methods.name: setZoomScaleNormal
methods.description: Sets the normal zoom scale, ensuring it is at least 1 or null.

methods.name: setShowZeros
methods.description: Sets whether zeros are displayed in the worksheet.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Returns the current sheet view type.

methods.name: setView
methods.description: Sets the sheet view type after validation against allowed types.
